purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: finance interview; vocabulary (資産/顧客/交渉/金額/会計) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 資産を守るには、何が大切ですか?
lines.style: professional adult interviewer voice, soft warm engaged clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 正しい会計と、計画が大切です。
lines.style: measured advisor voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 顧客は、どんな相談をしますか?
lines.style: engaged adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 顧客は、資産の運用を相談します。
lines.style: professional advisor voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 金額の決め方は、難しいですか?
lines.style: curious adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 金額は、顧客と交渉して決めます。
lines.en: The amount is decided by negotiating with the client.
lines.style: measured advisor voice, soft warm informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 交渉で、心がけることは?
lines.en: What do you keep in mind in negotiation?
lines.style: probing adult interviewer voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 会計を正直に示し、信頼を築きます。
lines.en: I honestly show the accounting and build trust.
lines.style: warm advisor voice, soft warm informative closing clarity throughout
